name: Indiabulls Ltd
title: Indiabulls Ltd - 533520 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Former fintech/broking group now real-estate-led; Q4 PAT INR194 cr mostly one-off-like first real-estate revenue recognition, with 2x/3x profit targets unsupported by quarterly guidance and no capacity/supply discipline data.

triggers.label: Real estate profit 2x FY27, 3x FY28
triggers.quote: real estate profits in FY27 expected to grow at least 2x from what it is today, and FY28 will be at least 3x from what it is here
triggers.highlight: real estate profits in FY27 expected to grow at least 2x

triggers.label: FY26 sales 21.6 lakh sq ft
triggers.quote: we sold about 21.6 lakh square feet throughout the year, and Q4 FY26 marks the first quarter of real estate revenue recognition
triggers.highlight: we sold about 21.6 lakh square feet throughout the year

triggers.label: NBFC loan book run-off, no fresh lending
triggers.quote: we are considering reducing the loan book slowly. So as of today we do not have any plans to disburse loans
triggers.highlight: we do not have any plans to disburse loans

guidance.quote: real estate profits in FY27 expected to grow at least 2x from what it is today
FY28 will be at least 3x from what it is here

guidance.value: approx 40 lakh sq ft, GDV INR6,000+ cr
guidance.quote: upcoming launches of approximately 40 lakh square feet in the cu rrent financial year with a GDV of INR6,000 plus crores

red_flags.label: Q4 profit driven by first real-estate revenue recognition
red_flags.quote: driven primarily by contribution from our real estate operation, giving us a profit of INR143 crores

red_flags.label: Weak broking and ARC returns; ARC profits deferred to FY27
red_flags.quote: the first year will go in getting adjusting the collections to the cost of our acquisition, and then the profits will roll in from ARC, which will start from next year

red_flags.label: Multi-year profit targets without quarterly guidance
red_flags.quote: It is difficult to give a quarter-to-quarter guidance knowing the nature of the business

red_flags.label: Inconsistent revenue figures between speech and notes
red_flags.quote: we delivered revenue of INR879* crores, supported by improving operating performance with profit after tax of INR346 crores

evasions.topic: Broking market share vs new entrants
evasions.quote: we got a new team for focusing on the online discount broking side
It should be about 1% or around that
We do not have any litigations going on and there is no financial implication to Indiabulls Limited
